newsitem.title: UK: Primesight Plc plans full LSE listing this summer.
newsitem.headline: Primesight Plc plans full LSE listing this summer.

text.p: Outdoor advertising specialist Primesight Plc said on Thursday it was planning a full listing on the London Stock Exchange this summer via a placing mainly with institutional investors.
The group, which is expected to have a market capitalisation of between 10 million and 15 million stg at issue, has two main businesses.

Primesight operates primarily in the construction of free-standing six-sheet poster sites, typically in retailers forecourts. Primesight International specialises in the selling of advertising space at international airports world-wide.
The group said it is hoping to raise four million stg of new money, which will be used to finance the expansion of both operations.
"We have currently 2,500 panels nation-wide and we are looking to have 8,000 by the end of the year 1999," said chief executive Charles Daniels in reference to the six-sheet business.
"This would then make us a national player."
The group said it will also use the funds to repay debt.
Primesight said it made pre-tax profits of 721,000 to the year end December 31, 1996 on turnover of 11.5 million stg.
